# ADR-3076: A07: MFA required key for privileged role 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Password-only admin access is insufficient.

## Decision

Privileged access configuration SHALL include an MFA required key for privileged role 4 (A07-4).

## Consequences

Phishing-resistant factors are preferred.
